Sinners Anonymous #3

Sinners Consumed

Somme Sketcher, Diana Botescu (Translator)

4.24
81,910 ratings7,527 reviews
Rate this book
Lumea mea e în flăcări, iar eu sunt obsedat de fata care a aprins chibritul.
Pumnii însângerați și trupul lipsit de viață de la picioarele mele confirmă totul: Penny este pierzania mea.
Masca mea de gentleman e doar o amintire.
Păcatele mi se scurg prin cămașă, asemenea cernelii.
Am încercat s-o las. N-am putut.
Am încercat s-o distrug. N-am fost în stare.
Așa că vom dansa încet printre flăcări, până când nu va mai rămâne din mine decât cenușă.
Și poate că voi renaște ca o Pasăre Phoenix doar atunci când ea va pleca.
Problema e că n-aș putea s-o las niciodată să plece.
Ca să scape de mine, ar trebui să fugă departe. Foarte departe.
Și poate că ar face-o... dacă i-aș spune adevărul:
Linia Sinners Anonymous îmi aparține.
Și am ascultat fiecare apel al ei.

Kiara

June 30, 2026
5 ⭐️ I have no words.

Actually… I have plenty of words because I NEED to talk about it.

This book completely consumed me. I finished it in less than 24 hours because putting it down simply wasn’t an option.

I loved the first part, but THIS?

This was everything I wanted and more. Everything I felt was missing was here. More romance. More spice. More banter. More swoony moments. More EVERYTHING.

"I'm your hotline now, Queenie. All your mundane thoughts, all your ramblings: they're mine. I want them all, no matter how trivial. Do you understand me?"

I swear every single chapter had me alternating between squealing, giggling, and kicking my feet.

╰┈➤ Rafe Visconti

Raphael Visconti…
The man that you are!!

I genuinely don’t think I’ve ever read about a man who was this hopelessly, embarrassingly, gloriously in love.

This man wasn’t just down bad. He was completely incapable of functioning without Penny.

“Soon, I just became obsessed with hearing you talk. About anything and everything—I didn't care. As long as your voice was in my ear, I was happy."

Even before the groveling started, he was already changing the little things simply because they mattered to Penny.

"Since when did you start drinking vodka?"
"Since you said you wouldn't kiss me if I drank whiskey."

SIR????

He gave up his drink because she didn’t like the taste of whiskey. Then he built her a bookshelf and filled it with the complete For Dummies collection because he knew they were her favorite books.

And then came the grovel.

"I'm off. Got shit to do."
"Like what?"
"Like Googling what the fuck groveling means."

I’M SORRY???

I don’t think I’ll ever recover from the fact that he literally Googled “how to grovel.”

And then he fully committed to it.

He learned how to braid her hair.
He waited outside her apartment all night because he knew she’d sleep better in his car.

And don’t even get me started on the Penelope Price For Dummies book because I actually cannot.

“It takes me a moment to realize it's the tissue I left in his private bathroom the very first time he let me use it.”

Yeah… I’m unwell.

╰┈➤ Penny Price

“She can have my drink. Fuck, she can have it all. There's nothing I wouldn't give her, and that's the problem.”

What I loved most was that Penny made him WORK for it. And THANK GOD she did.

She refused to let him off easy, and watching Rafe slowly realize that flowers and one apology weren’t going to cut it was SO satisfying.

"To me, you're the unluckiest girl in the world." Instinct pulls me away from him, but he only tightens his grip on my neck. "But you're also the prettiest. The funniest. The fucking rudest. You've ruined my life but I'm not strong enough to stop you."

╰┈➤ Side Characters

One of my favorite things about this series is that it feels so much bigger than just the romance.

The found family is EVERYTHING.

Every group scene had me smiling, and I loved getting more of the Visconti brothers. The banter between them was genuinely hilarious.

"No one eat the turkey," he murmurs, cutting a glance behind him. "It's as pink as Barbie's playhouse. There's eight bathrooms in this house, and twelve of us; you do the math."

Rory and Angelo somehow managed to become even cuter, and every scene with them made me so happy. And Nico??? 🥹 Give this man his own book IMMEDIATELY.

╰┈➤ Final Take

The only thing that surprised me was how much the mafia plot took a back seat. I expected the external conflict to play a slightly bigger role by the end, but honestly… I wasn’t even mad about it.

The characters completely carried this book.

"Because even though I'm unlucky with you, I feel even unluckier without you."

I genuinely don’t know what Somme Sketcher puts in these books because they’re ridiculously addictive.

I could read ten more books of Rafe and Penny doing absolutely nothing except arguing, flirting, watching TV, and falling even more in love. That’s how attached I’ve become to these characters.

Rafe and Penny officially own a piece of my heart.

No…

Actually, they can have the whole thing.

"Come home, Queenie. Come home and let me worship you every day for the rest of your life."

5/5 ☆

“𝐘𝐨𝐮’𝐯𝐞 𝐫𝐮𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐝 𝐦𝐲 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐈’𝐦 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐞𝐧𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐭𝐨 𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐩 𝐲𝐨𝐮.”

I could have another book on Rafe and Penny and I still wouldn’t be satisfied. Somme knows how to write angst and tension like no other! Again, I found myself just enamored by their interactions and how much Rafe loves her. He goes through stages in this book where he grapples with what he feels for Penny, how much it physically and mentally overwhelms him as he tries to make sense of it, while at the same time trying to retain his reputation as a Visconti brother. We have this very obvious “masculine” character who has stayed away from women like Penny all of his life, but the instant that he meets her and their relationship develops, he can’t help but risk everything at the chance of being with her. UGH!!!! I need a Rafe.

Rafe and Penny are the epitome of “I hate you but I love you and can’t imagine life without you.” This was honestly everything I wanted and more (except an epilogue. I wanted an epilogue, Somme). The friendships between all the girls, Rory, Penny, Wren, Tayce - LOVE. I want to desperately be a part of that friend group!! We also get to see more of Rory and Angelo and they have gotten even cuter since book 1.

Somme’s writing is engaging, detailed and so, so funny. I cannot wait for the next book. ♡ If you haven’t read this series, this is your sign!!!

Rating: 4.5 stars.
This book didn’t need to be a duet, but did I devour it? Hell yes, left no crumbs. I honestly thought it could have wrapped up perfectly in a single 500-page book, but selfishly, I’m so glad it’s a duet because I want to live in this world forever. Every scene had me giggling, gasping, and sometimes even kicking my feet like a giddy fool. It reminded me of that pure, fluttery feeling I’ve been missing for so long, finally, it found its way back to my heart.

I expected a little more plot and action, but instead, it leaned fully into the romance, and honestly, I wasn’t complaining. The tension, the playful banter, and the quiet, heart-melting moments between the characters had me hooked from start to finish. It’s exactly the kind of story you want to binge in one sitting… if only I had the time, which I don’t these days, sadly.

While I can’t give it the same wholehearted praise as the first book, there were moments that felt a bit blank, and I wanted to know more about the world and side characters, it still landed perfectly because it came into my reading life at exactly the right time. It’s cozy, swoony, and just chaotic enough to keep my heart racing, and I can’t wait to see where the rest of the duet takes me.

── .✦

Okay, first of all… I honestly don’t even know where to start because this book COMPLETELY wrecked me, and I mean that in the absolute best way possible. I’m officially obsessed. Every nerve in my body was on high alert, my heart racing, my smile permanently plastered across my face, and my jaw just on the floor for most of it. I couldn’t tear my eyes away for a single second, I was fangirling so hard that I nearly forgot to breathe. Every twist, every interaction, every tiny detail had me gasping, laughing, and gasping again. It was intense, chaotic, swoony, and emotional all at once, like a perfect storm of everything I didn’t know I needed. I’m officially shook, obsessed, and fully committed to reliving every moment over and over again.

── .✦

°˖➴ Penny Price:
“Because even though I’m unlucky with you, I feel even unluckier without you.”
Okay, so yes, it’s the same person, but I felt such a huge change in her character and mindset this time around. I really love her because she’s so different from other FMCs in dark romance books, and that’s exactly why I’m obsessed with how she reacts and feels. In this book, she felt more powerful, more in control, and more complex than in the first one, and I honestly loved that so much. At first, I doubted she would be different, but she completely impressed me, and I’m giving her all the credit she deserves for that growth!


°˖➴ Rafe Viscouti:
“I’ll give you the world in every color if you want it.”
And Rafe Visconti… ohhhhhh, I need to have a serious conversation with the universe, because does any mother out there give birth to a man even remotely similar to him?? Because if yes, I need his coordinates IMMEDIATELY. This man is my Roman Empire. My emotional support menace. My final downfall. Saying I’m obsessed with him is such an understatement it’s almost disrespectful. I haven’t been this unhinged over a dark romance MMC in SO long, and the way he has me screaming into the void?? Horrifying. Tragic. Perfect.

⊱ ۫ ׅ ✧ “Come home, Queenie. Come home and let me worship you every day for the rest of your life.”

Now let’s break down the scenes that genuinely fried my last remaining brain cell:
✨ He quit drinking whiskey, HIS drink, HIS thing, just because she doesn’t like the taste of it. So he switches to vodka so she’ll kiss him?? BABE, BE SERIOUS.
✨ He cooked for her. Not “made a sandwich.” Full-on cooked. Like a future husband in training. Like he’s preparing for domestic life.
✨ He drove around in his car while she slept because he knew she can’t sleep alone… the tenderness?? The devotion?? I was kicking my feet like a twelve-year-old at a boyband concert.
✨ He built her a bookshelf and bought her the entire “For Dummies” collection because it’s her favorite. A man building furniture?? Personal?? For her?? I passed away and came back.
✨ He googled “how to grovel.” I repeat: THIS MAN WENT TO GOOGLE DOT COM and typed THAT. And then chased her everywhere like a lovesick, determined feral shadow. I respect the hustle.
✨ He called her “Queenie.” And somehow managed to make it sound both reverent and possessive. I melted.
✨ He can’t keep his hands off her, meanwhile she’s out here practicing emotional restraint when she’s mad at him. The contrast?? The dynamic?? Inject it into my veins.

⊱ ۫ ׅ ✧ “What are you doing here?”
“I’m groveling”

Rafe Visconti is a problem. The kind of problem you don’t want solutions for. The type of man who makes you forget your standards, your morals, your entire personality.
I fear I might took him away from Penny..
I need twenty more books of him.


⊱ ۫ ׅ ✧ “You’ve ruined my life but I’m not strong enough to stop you.”

…

⊱ ۫ ׅ ✧ “Hang your stolen clothes up in my closet, make your god-awful lasagnas in my oven. Light your girly candles in every room. I want all of it, all of you. Just come home.”

── .✦

I adored their scenes together. Honestly, every time Angelo, Rory, Nico, and my mysterious king Gabe appeared, it felt like the entire atmosphere shifted. There’s something so heartwarming about watching these men, who once lived in chaos, darkness, and violence, slowly soften because of the people they love. It’s like witnessing sunlight crack through a storm for the first time.

And it just kills me that they’re fictional. Like WHY did the universe give us these men on paper instead of in real life?? Because I swear, I’d adopt Nico as my chaotic best friend instantly, and Rafe… well, Rafe could ruin my whole life and I’d thank him for the experience.

Nico, oh my god, the way he pretends he doesn’t care but loves harder than anyone? The sarcasm. The loyalty. The way he’d burn the world down for the people he loves but still complains the whole time? Iconic. I need that energy in my life.

And GABE… don’t even get me started. You can FEEL that his story is going to destroy every one of our emotional stability levels in the best possible way. The man radiates mystery, depth, restrained emotion, and that quiet intensity that hints at a backstory we are absolutely not ready for. The way he watches everyone, listens more than he speaks, and acts like he’s untouchable? Yeah, no. He’s going to fall the hardest. And the groveling? BABY I am READY. I want to see this serious, composed man absolutely lose his mind for one woman.

And Rory and Angelo? Precious. It’s so refreshing to see them actually growing, evolving, and letting themselves feel something other than rage and duty. This whole friend group is such a beautiful mess, a bunch of emotionally wounded men who somehow found love, loyalty, and a new kind of happiness. It warms my cold little heart.

Honestly… it’s painful that they don’t exist. I need:
➛ Nico as my chaos best friend.
➛ Gabe as my slow-burn obsession.
➛ Angelo as my unhinged hype man.
➛ Rory as that grounding presence.
➛ And Rafe as my religion.

These books grabbed me by the soul and refused to let go.

↳ Sinners Anonymous Series:
» Sinners Anonymous ᝰ 4 stars.
» Sinners Condemned ᝰ 4.5 stars.
» Sinners Atone ᝰ 1 star.

>>> ──────── .✦

ִֶָ𓂃 ࣪˖ ִִֶֶָ🥀་༘࿐ No explanation needed for why I’m picking this up immediately. The urge is instant. The excitement? Off the charts. I’m genuinely so ready to throw myself into this duet, especially since I had no idea it was a duet to begin with. I really thought everything would be rushed and tied up in one book, but nope… I was so wrong, and honestly? I’m thrilled about it.

So now, this book is officially serving as my big, dramatic entrance into the chaos. <𝟑 .ᐟ

I’m so in love with this book, it’s ridiculous. The way it was just pure and utter perfection has to be CRIMINAL!!! There was literally not a moment where I wasn’t grinning and giggling my ass off (except for the sad parts ofc)!! I literally stared at my phone like that: :D, the whole freaking time while reading this book!!!

It was also such a huge improvement from book 1! While I did love book 1, book 2 was just so much more better for some reason to and it had everything book 1 somehow missed out on.

This book made me feel nothing but joy, giddiness and just every positive emotion there is!! In my eyes, this book had absolutely 0 flaws and I’m just so freaking obsessed with it, Penny and Rafe! Like these two own my heart and soul now and I’m most definitely NOT mad about that!!!

Penny is literally such an ICON!!! The way she literally slept with him one night, only to make him grovel the next day… WHAT A QUEEN!!! And the way she really made him beg for her forgiveness was EVERYTHING!! She was literally walking him like a dog! Bro was on his knees for her!! It was just so epic and so freaking entertaining!!

She’s in general such a strong and badass person! Finding out more about her fucked up past and what she has experienced at such a young age, broke my freaking heart. She’s such an amazing character and I honestly can’t get enough of her. I’m so going to miss reading her POVs!!

Now, don’t get me even started on my love for Rafe! I already thought that Angelo was amazing but Rafe?!?!? Bro took it to the next fucking level!!!!

The way he is so fucking obsessed with her was just too good to be true!!! Like he literally craved to be with her!! If my man isn’t like that, then I don’t want him!

He killed for her, even though he is a pretty clean and neat guy! And he brought her back a finger as a souvenir?!?! ICONIC!! He loved Whiskey but only drinks Vodka from now on, because of the chance of him kissing Penny because she hates the taste of Whiskey!!
He proved to her in so many ways how he is different from all the bad guys she has experienced before!! Anddddd… He literally asked for advice on how to properly grovel!!
In conclusion, I’m in love.

He’s just perfection! And so were the many moments between them!

Like… them not kissing until the 70ish% mark of the SECOND book was just everything!!! And the kiss was just so freaking AMAZING!!! He literally kissed her in the rain because that was the only way she wanted it to happen!!! I’m on my freaking knees!!
He let her use all his money just so she would forgive him but she didn’t care about that because she only wanted him to prove her that he truly loves her!!
And the way these two broke every rule they had about love and relationships, for each other… ugh.. I DIED DEAD!!!

Also… the fact that they’re literally soulmates?!?! The way they’re connected to one another by ‘bad luck’?!?! The fact that they thought that they were doomed and not meant to be together?!?!
Somehow the more I think about them and their relationship, the more I realise how perfect they are for one another!!!

Let’s just say that this book has me in a freaking chokehold which I will most likely never escape from! I will be spending the next few days on tiktok, scrolling through edits and videos of these two and this book!! Like.. how can I not?!?!

Overall, another 6+ star dark romance book for me and I’m most definitely not complaining! Somme Sketcher is a GENIUS!!! And I can’t wait until Gabe’s book comes out in September!! Sooo excited to see where the rest of the series is going!!

I don’t think it needed to be a duet. This book was really just a continuation of the last book. No different stakes or plot, nothing shifted in the story, it just carried on exactly where it left off. I think it may be why I feel like it’s missing something to me. I thought there might have been a bigger plot outside the couple that they would have to deal with or something to make it need a duet but there wasn’t anything really.

I think I’m just not feeling it but I get why others love this book. Like I said, there’s nothing wrong with it, and I liked the romance a lot, I just wanted more.

14/04/23 - my third re-read! This is my comfort book for when I'm not feeling great mentally.

I think Somme Sketcher could write a 100 books about Penny and Rafe and it would never be enough. I cannot express how much I love these two and I want my own Rafe.

This book is Part 2 of a duet. Having 600 pages+ for their story was just perfection and I couldn't read it quick enough.

The writing, the pacing, the banter was fantastic. I hate when banter between a couple disappears once they're finally together, but Somme manages to balance this perfectly. This honestly has to be one of my favourite duets I've ever read and I cannot wait for Gabe's story.

If you love a good mafia romance with a strong FMC and a grumpy MMC, this is the book. The chemistry flies off the page and I found myself laughing out-loud several times. This book is honestly 6 stars!!

Somme, what do I have to do to get Gabe's book in my hands now?????
